payload.title: Run credential-free integration acceptance and rollout
payload.description:
Purpose: Integrate, verify, and roll out the application-authenticated local workflow.

Acceptance:
- Python 3.11 and 3.12 CI pass.
- Dashboard typecheck, unit, Storybook build, and browser tests pass.
- Sandbox environment contains no AWS profile or session variables.
- One plexus login supports an accuracy evaluation with a stored dataset.
- A feedback evaluation persists complete root-cause evidence.
- A local optimizer checkpoints and resumes with final artifacts visible in the dashboard.
- An expired access token refreshes without user or AWS intervention.
- Additive backend support deploys before migrated clients.
- Production acceptance uses a controlled evaluation with no local AWS credentials.

Close only after final rollout verification is recorded.
